(() => { const isShown = element => { if (!element) return false; element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant', block: 'center' }); const box = element.getBoundingClientRect(); const hit = document.elementFromPoint(box.left + box.width / 2, box.top + box.height / 2); return !!hit && element.contains(hit); }; const pending = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(button => button.textContent.includes('Follow after reply.')); return { phoneFits: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= 360, pendingVisible: isShown(pending), stopReachable: isShown(document.querySelector('button[aria-label=Stop]')) }; })()

(() => { const isShown = element => { if (!element) return false; element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant', block: 'center' }); const box = element.getBoundingClientRect(); const hit = document.elementFromPoint(box.left + box.width / 2, box.top + box.height / 2); return !!hit && element.contains(hit); }; const pending = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(button => button.textContent.includes('Follow after reply.')); return { phoneFits: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= 360, pendingVisible: isShown(pending), stopReachable: isShown(document.querySelector('button[aria-label=Stop]')) }; })()

(async () => { const shown = () => document.body.innerText; for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 200 && !document.querySelector('main').innerText.includes('Sent during a reply'); attempt += 1) await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); return { steerDelivered: document.querySelector('main').innerText.includes('Sent during a reply'), steerLeftList: !shown().includes('Steers this reply at its next step'), queuedStillWaits: shown().includes('Sends after this reply') && !!document.querySelector('button[aria-label=Stop]') }; })()
